sections.heading: C - California Driver's Handbook Section Six: Navigating the Roads
sections.markdown:
## C - California Driver's Handbook Section Six: Navigating the Roads

FACT_ID: sec06-F01 | anchor: A01
Lanes carry single traffic lines, markings assign road space, and a lone solid yellow centers two-way roads and bars passing when bordering your single lane [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-F02 | anchor: A01
Never cross double solid yellows save HOV entrances, signed closures, lefts and U-turns over one set; twin sets two-plus feet apart bar all but gap crossings [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-F03 | anchor: A01
Pass on broken yellow beside your lane when safe; single solid white divides same-direction lanes including one-ways [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec06-F04 | anchor: A02
Double solid white walls off preferential lanes like HOV and rims ramps; never cross, and wait for broken white [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec06-F05 | anchor: A02
Broken white splits same-direction lanes; oversized broken lines warn of lane ends, heed exit and merge signs; yield triangles mark stop-or-yield points [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec06-F06 | anchor: A03
Lanes number outward from Number 1; pass or turn left from the left, enter and exit from the right; far-left passing and reserved HOV lanes serve named users [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec06-F07 | anchor: A03
Signal lane changes, scan mirrors, sides, shoulder, blind spots, confirm room, hold speed; shun weaves, late moves, finish turns and crossings, loop back legally after a miss [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec06-F08 | anchor: A04
HOV lanes take qualifying carpools, buses, decal low-emission cars, motorcycles per posted counts and hours, show diamonds and Carpool Lane paint, open only at marked entries [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec06-F09 | anchor: A04
Center turn lanes take turns only, at most two hundred feet, via signal-shoulder-merge; slow two-laners must duck into turnouts past five followers [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec06-F10 | anchor: A05
Bike lanes belong to cyclists, show white lines, signs, green paint, and admit drivers only to park, enter or leave, or turn within two hundred feet [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec06-F11 | anchor: A05
Six bikeways: plain, buffered, route, boulevard, separated track, shared sharrow; check blind spots first, ride motorized bikes gently, hold three feet from cyclists [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec06-F12 | anchor: A06
Start right turns at the right edge or opening, borrow bike lanes only nearby, watch spots and curb users, signal near one hundred feet, check right, slow [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec06-F13 | anchor: A06
The limit line is the wide white stop bar; stop at it, else the crosswalk, else the intersection mouth; then left-right-left, turn safe, land right and tight [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec06-F14 | anchor: A06
Right on red follows a full stop unless NO TURN ON RED bars it, red arrows forbid rights till green, bus lanes ban driving and parking but let you cross to turn [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec06-F15 | anchor: A07
Dedicated right-turn lanes skip merging and stopping, beat through-traffic reds, obey their own curb signals, still yield crosswalks [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec06-F16 | anchor: A07
Lefts hug the divider or opening, join center lanes within two hundred feet, honor occupants, yield walkers, signal one hundred feet out, stop in order, swing to the left lane, hold wheels straight till committed, then accelerate [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec06-F17 | anchor: A08
Left on red works only one-way to one-way without a ban sign, yielding green traffic, walkers, and riders after looking both ways [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec06-F18 | anchor: A08
Make U-turns with a signal from the left lane across double yellows, in residential two-hundred-foot gaps, at green lights lacking NO U-TURN signs, or through divided openings [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec06-F19 | anchor: A08
Skip U-turns at posted signs, on crossings, over dividers and twin double yellows, under two-hundred-foot sight, on one-ways, at fire stations and driveways, in business blocks except intersections and openings [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec06-F20 | anchor: A09
Diagrams: two-way lefts center to center, rights hug the edge, two-way-to-one-way lefts start far-left, end anywhere past three lanes, one-way lefts start far-left, curb users and arrows govern [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec06-F21 | anchor: A10
One-way-to-one-way lefts start far-left with cyclist lane rights and open endings past three lanes; matching rights start far-right and end anywhere; T turns yield to through traffic, split from center [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec06-F22 | anchor: A10
Brake by coasting off the gas, pressing lightly to a stop with room and time, holding behind limit lines, leaving rear-wheel sight gaps behind cars [A10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec06-F23 | anchor: A11
Merging yields: ramp lane at traffic speed, safe gaps sans stopping, signal, mirror, shoulder, three seconds, no solids, single-lane crosses with fresh checks [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec06-F24 | anchor: A11
Exits need foreknowledge, single signaled shoulder-checked moves, a five-second four-hundred-foot signal in the exit lane, safe speed, no solid crossings [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec06-F25 | anchor: A12
Enter signaled with room: half a block near one hundred fifty feet in town, a full block near three hundred on highways; shun blocked intersections, fake right blinkers until turns truly start [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec06-F26 | anchor: A12
Pass with room past oncoming users and hills, curves, and junctions a third of a mile out, scanning for drifters; never on blind hills or curves, within one hundred feet of intersections, bridges, tunnels, crossings, or hazards, at driveways, sans reentry room [A12].
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec06-F27 | anchor: A13
Pass via signal, shoulder, lane, speed, signal-back; right-side passes fit multi-lane highways, left-turning leaders, one-ways, never off pavement or left of signalers; when passed, hold lane and speed [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec06-F28 | anchor: A14
Parallel park with three extra feet: signal, pair two feet out, check spots, back forty-five degrees, straighten inside eighteen inches, settle parallel, brake, shut off, exit past traffic [A14].
Source: [A14 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec06-F29 | anchor: A15
Back straight after traffic and blind checks, signal to the curb then cancel, mirror and shoulder-check, roll three vehicle lengths inside three feet watching behind, steer smooth, repeat to depart [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec06-F30 | anchor: A15
Hill parks set brake and park or gear; driveways aim out of the street, downhills bite the curb, uphills face center then kiss the curb rolling back, curbless slopes point right off-center [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec06-F31 | anchor: A16
White loads people briefly, green caps stays per postings, yellow loads freight on posted clocks with drivers aboard, red bans stopping save marked buses, blue needs disability placards via the disabled-parking pages [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-F32 | anchor: A16
Never park at NO PARKING signs, crosswalks, sidewalks, driveways, ramp three-foot zones, wheelchair curbs, disabled crosshatch, zero-emission bays, tunnels, bridges, hydrant and station fifteen-foot zones, crosswalk twenty-foot zones or fifteen at curb extensions, safety gaps, or doubled up [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec06-F33 | anchor: A17
Wrong-side and freeway parking need emergencies, officer orders, posted leave; freeway stops go fully off pavement behind locked doors under four hours; locals may reserve EV bays; drive green via smooth steady driving, kept tires, oil, filters, shed weight, per fueleconomy.gov [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-F34 | anchor: A17
At stops signal right, take the full shoulder even from HOV, find light, mute the radio, stay seated, drop the window, show hands, hear the reason before questioning save imminent peril, reasons logged on paper [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec06-F35 | anchor: A18
Decline searches aloud, never resist lawful ones; show license, insurance, registration or face limited searches; treat passenger ID as declinable-yet-sometimes-required, state refusals clearly, never meddle, obey seat orders; save immigration answers for federal officers [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec06-F36 | anchor: A19
Public recording is protected when announced and non-interfering, concealed reaches need permission, devices stay untouched, phones stay locked outside parole, retaliation is banned, rights gripes stay verbal [A19].
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec06-F37 | anchor: A19
Complain to the officer's agency for investigation, free from retaliation and bias across race, sex, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, medical condition, citizenship status; contacts at post.ca.gov/le-agencies [A19].
Source: [A19 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]
